svg.title: PetaJournal frontends: browser, SwiftUI, WinUI, Emacs, Android, todo and stickies
svg.desc: Five frontends share one core. The Android frontend is frontend-android (Kotlin, Compose), connected by bincode over BoltFFI to a Rust library with shell-android, shell-native, peta-core, embedded-journal and journal-core. shell-android is the entrance, and it gives shell-native the way to embedded-journal. It asks no server: embedded-journal calls journal-core, the inside of the journal server, in the same library. journal-core keeps a SQLite database in the app and syncs the pages with the .md files of a folder of the app, in both directions. The Kotlin side downloads and uploads those files with the Dropbox SDK. The browser frontend is one WASM binary with shell-leptos (Rust, Leptos) and peta-core (Rust, Crux), and talks to the server with fetch and EventSource. It shows an item from the HTML that flatmarkdown-ast2html makes of its AST, and adds the link targets, the image sizes and the code colours itself. It parses no Markdown: the HTML of a copy comes from the AST of the server too. The SwiftUI frontend is frontend-swiftui (SwiftUI), connected by bincode over BoltFFI to a Rust library with shell-native, peta-core and server-client (Rust, ureq). shell-native makes the HTML of an item with flatmarkdown-ast2html, and the app draws it. The WinUI frontend is frontend-winui (C#, WinUI), connected by bincode over BoltFFI to the same Rust library with shell-native. The Emacs frontend is peta-journal.el (Emacs Lisp), connected by JSON lines over stdin and stdout to a Rust process with shell-emacs, peta-core and server-client. Two more frontends do not use the core. The todo frontend (TypeScript, React) talks to the server with fetch and EventSource, and renders the AST with flatmarkdown-ast2react, a TypeScript package. The stickies frontend (C#, WinUI) talks to the server with HttpClient, and renders the AST with flatmarkdown-ast2html. The local server has two parts. journal-server (Rust, axum) serves REST and SSE at /api/events. It also serves MCP at /mcp. It calls journal-core (Rust) in the same process. journal-core keeps the pages in a SQLite database. It syncs the pages with .md files in a local folder outside the server, in both directions. A cloud storage service such as Dropbox may sync that folder with remote machines. An AI agent talks to it as an MCP client over Streamable HTTP. The folders of .md files are painted yellow. The local server is painted gray. One ribbon of the same colour joins journal-core of the server and journal-core of Android.
svg.text: Leptos・Emacs・SwiftUI・WinUI・Androidは、同じpeta-coreを呼ぶ。Androidは、サーバの代わりにjournal-coreを組み込む。

g.text: Emacsフロントエンド（peta-journalモード）
リンク・画像・色付けを補う
行を描画・操作を報告
画面を描画・操作を送信
画面を描画・操作を送信
画面を描画・操作を送信
DB・同期・検索・拡張関数
タスクを一覧・状態を切り替えできるWebアプリ
ページを付箋紙として表示できるデスクトップアプリ
ページを検索・読み書き
ToDoアプリ、Stickiesアプリは、Readが中心の単純なものなので、コアを使わず、サーバと直接話す。
画像は、どのフロントエンドも、画面の側がサーバから直接取る。
項目の表示は、Leptos・SwiftUI・WinUI・Android・Stickiesのどれも、ast2htmlが作るHTMLから描く。Emacsは、Markdownのまま見せる。
